title: Annotatio III §.II: Occasional cause of Ortus — GENERALIOR = hyperbolic / catachrestic Fathers on Eucharistic symbols
pass_a_gloss: §. II. Among the CAUSES of the Ortus it also helps to attend to the Occasional, which they call a cause by accident. Of this sort one is More General, another More Special. I shall judge the MORE GENERAL to be the Hyperbolic, nay sometimes catachrestic, locutions of the Fathers, both Greek and Latin, about the Eucharistic Symbols, by which, unless they are taken skillfully, the unwary are easily led off into errors.
pass_b_english: §.II Ortus causes: also the Occasional (cause by accident).
GENERALIOR: hyperbolic — sometimes even catachrestic — Father-speech on Eucharistic symbols; mishandled, it leads the unwary into error.
source_text: §. II. Inter Ortûs CAUSAS attendere quoque juvat Occasionalem, quam causam per accidens vocant. Hujusmodi alia Generalior, Specialior alia est. GENERALIOREM existimavero, Hyperbolicas, quin quandoque catachresticas Patrum, tam Græcorum, quàm Latinorum de Symbolis Eucharisticis, locutiones, quibus, nisi dextrè capiantur, incauti facile in errores abducuntur.
